patches.purpose: llama_model_init_from_user: absent optional tensors and skipped tensors (MTP with load_mtp off) stay absent, as in file mode

ggml-cpu (AArch64 dotprod): 2x2 tiles for Q5_K/IQ2_XXS/IQ3_XXS bitwise equal to one-column dot products; four-row single-column kernels for IQ2_XS/IQ4_NL bitwise equal to one-row dot products, off unless ggml_cpu_set_row_kernels enables them; MUL_MAT pairs columns for odd batches; MUL_MAT_ID pairs tokens routed to the same expert; tiled GEMM path enabled on AArch64 i8mm with a USMMLA microkernel; NEON simd_gemm for SVE builds; MUL_MAT_ID expert-address hook for slot-addressed expert caches; MUL_MAT_ID processes experts reported ready by an optional hook first, so an expert cache can overlap a pending read with the other experts' work (same results); an external compute hook lets the host run selected nodes elsewhere (Equity's GPU mode computes prompt-sized products and DeltaNet nodes on the GPU; unused unless installed)

llama_set_adapter_cvec_ablation: optional in-graph directional ablation in the control-vector adapter (each selected block output h becomes h - s*d*(d^T h) for that block's unit direction d), used by Equity's negative steering strengths; unused unless set

qwen4exp: names the post-attention hyper-connection streams attn_residual, as qwen35 names its residual, so Equity's expert store can predict the next layer's routing from them; applies the control-vector adapter (addition and directional ablation) to every stream of each block output, which the upstream graph never called; prefetches the n-gram rows of a token also when the table is a host file mapping (Equity maps it itself, so llama.cpp's lazy-read flag is unset). A node name, an adapter call and a madvise hint; no numerical change while no control vector is set

ggml_backend_sched_get_buffer_chunk / ggml_gallocr_get_buffer_chunk: the scheduler's compute buffer chunks, so Equity can return a prompt's activation pages while decoding (decode_reclaims_compute). Accessors only

llama_set_kv_buft_override: the host may choose the buffer type of each KV cache layer (by cache tag and layer); Equity maps the attention keys and values of sparse-attention models from a file on storage (kv_file_dir). Unused unless set

A decoding step of one sequence reads its recurrent states (DeltaNet and convolution) in place from the cache row they are written back to, instead of gathering a copy (3 MiB per DeltaNet layer on Qwen3.8); the row first receives a different source row. Bitwise equal; rollback slots and multi-token batches keep the gather

vulkan_headers.purpose: C++ Vulkan headers for GGML's Vulkan backend (GPU mode); the NDK ships only the C headers

spirv_headers.purpose: SPIR-V headers required by GGML's Vulkan backend (GPU mode)
